mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier(name, contact, phone, address, main_category, remark, is_active, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{mainCategory}, #{remark}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM supplier ORDER BY is_active DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM supplier WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order(order_no, supplier_id, status, total_cost_cent, item_count, received_at, operator, remark, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{status}, #{totalCostCent}, #{itemCount}, #{receivedAt}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO purchase_item(purchase_id, product_id, qty, unit_cost_cent, amount_cent, batch_no, expire_on, remark) VALUES (#{purchaseId}, #{productId}, #{qty}, #{unitCostCent}, #{amountCent}, #{batchNo}, #{expireOn}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_order SET total_cost_cent = #{totalCostCent}, item_count = #{itemCount} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, p.name AS product_name, p.spec AS product_spec FROM purchase_item i JOIN product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_order SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE order_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_batch(product_id, purchase_item_id, batch_no, expire_on, qty_in, qty_left, unit_cost_cent, source, status, received_at, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{purchaseItemId}, #{batchNo}, #{expireOn}, #{qtyIn}, #{qtyLeft}, #{unitCostCent}, #{source}, #{status}, #{receivedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_batch WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'NORMAL' AND qty_left > 0 AND (expire_on IS NULL OR expire_on >= #{today}) ORDER BY (expire_on IS NULL) ASC, expire_on ASC, received_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT b.*, p.name AS product_name, p.spec AS product_spec FROM product_batch b JOIN product p ON p.id = b.product_id
AND b.product_id = #{productId} AND b.status = #{status}
AND b.expire_on IS NOT NULL AND b.expire_on <= date('now','localtime','+' || #{expiringDays} || ' day')
ORDER BY (b.expire_on IS NULL) ASC, b.expire_on ASC, b.id DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_batch WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status <> 'VOID'
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(qty_left), 0) FROM product_batch WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status <> 'VOID'
mapper.update: UPDATE product_batch SET qty_left = qty_left - #{qty}, status = CASE WHEN qty_left - #{qty} = 0 THEN 'EXHAUSTED' ELSE status END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'NORMAL' AND qty_left >= #{qty}
UPDATE product_batch SET qty_left = qty_left + #{qty}, status = CASE WHEN status = 'EXHAUSTED' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE status END WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'VOID'
UPDATE product_batch SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_take(take_no, scope, scope_value, status, item_count, diff_count, diff_amount_cent, started_at, operator, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{takeNo}, #{scope}, #{scopeValue}, #{status}, #{itemCount}, #{diffCount}, #{diffAmountCent}, #{startedAt}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO stock_take_item(take_id, product_id, system_qty, counted_qty, diff_qty, cost_cent, reason, remark) VALUES (#{takeId}, #{productId}, #{systemQty}, #{countedQty}, #{diffQty}, #{costCent}, #{reason}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_take WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT i.*, p.name AS product_name, p.spec AS product_spec FROM stock_take_item i JOIN product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.take_id = #{takeId} ORDER BY p.category, p.name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_take
AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_take_item i JOIN stock_take t ON t.id = i.take_id WHERE i.product_id = #{productId} AND t.status = 'COUNTING'
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_take_item SET counted_qty = #{countedQty}, reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE stock_take_item SET diff_qty = #{diffQty} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE stock_take SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, diff_count = #{diffCount}, diff_amount_cent = #{diffAmountCent}, operator = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COUNTING'
UPDATE stock_take SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COUNTING'
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM product
AND category = #{scopeValue}
AND INSTR(',' || #{scopeValue} || ',', ',' || id || ',') > 0
ORDER BY category, name
SELECT * FROM stock_take ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_take WHERE take_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
